user.title: Live Track Aircraft
user.description: Aircraft within the radius appear on the map as they arrive and depart on their own. Point it anywhere — it defaults to your Home Assistant location, but you can watch any airspace in the world.

data.card_rotation: Let the map card rotate the icons
data.silhouette_only: Draw icons without a background disc

data_description.latitude: Centre of the area to watch.
data_description.longitude: Centre of the area to watch.
data_description.radius_km: How far out counts as overhead.
data_description.max_aircraft: A safety ceiling, not a display limit. Filter the map card to show fewer.
data_description.card_rotation: Off: icons arrive already rotated and work on any map card. On: icons arrive unrotated for a card that can turn them, which lets a course change slide instead of jump.
data_description.silhouette_only: Off: each icon sits on its own dark disc and reads on any map card. On: the aircraft outline alone, for a card that draws markers with a transparent background. Light and heavy aircraft then show their difference in size.

abort.already_configured: Aircraft are already tracked for this location and radius.
